what: Skin name for each section (data-bg="base|contrast|accent" …or a name the author makes up) is attached, then while the section crosses the 50% line of the viewport height, html[data-page-theme] becomes that name, and the page background, text and accent colors (--fx-theme-bg, ink, accent) blend over .8s ease. Going down from an ink-black section to a gray-blue one tints the whole page at once. On first load the page stands in the skin of the section on the line, with no transition. If data-bg is changed inside a section (before/after toggle), it follows right away when that section is the current one

options.line: Reference line — screen-height ratio (default .5) or distance from top of screen (300px)
options.attr: Attribute to read the skin name from, default data-bg
options.base: Skin for when no Section hangs on the line, default base
options.--fx-theme-ease: Blend-transition curve (in css, on :root), default ease — the original uses cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1)

use: <main data-fx="section-theme-switch"><section data-bg="base">…</section><section data-bg="contrast">…</section></main> — To add more names: :root[data-page-theme="Name"] { --fx-theme-bg: …; --fx-theme-ink: …; --fx-theme-accent: … } In the css on the side that uses it

from.where: shared.js section skins (black·neue·nebula-light) — original html[data-theme] + @property --page-bg·fg·accent .8s ease, reference line 50%

shared.js current section → html[data-coloroverwrite] — each product category section has a data-color (four Key·Sub pairs), and the page background and the big back logo pattern color change in .8s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1). The original picks the section whose center is closest to the screen center, and releases the overwrite once the footer passes half the screen

shared.js · shared.css skin flip — original ThemeMotion: when the second group’s first section header reaches 300px above the top of the screen (line: 300px), dozens of registered color variables on body (including the header line and buttons) go from the dark panel → light panel over .6s cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955) (--fx-theme-dur · --fx-theme-ease). The consumer side receives fx:theme (detail.instant) and turns off the button’s own transition for 650ms

shared.js · shared.css section accent color — in the original, once a section’s top edge passes 20px above the viewport top (line: 20px), the top-left DT square background · nav text switch to that section’s color (data-accent-color) over .35s cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1) (--fx-theme-dur · --fx-theme-ease) and theme-color follows with a 350ms sine. Sections paint their own background, so --fx-theme-bg is always the background color

note: The element carrying the part paints the background (the consuming side lays var(--fx-theme-bg) on body and html too, so even the gaps between sections get the same color). Sections themselves must not paint a background, so the page looks tinted all at once · if fx:theme detail.instant is true, it was matched at first open (without a transition).
